title: Roadmap Lane Orchestrator and Blocker Taxonomy
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background:
Redwood's roadmap coordination has increasingly shown gaps in cross-team visibility for critical handoffs (Eng, Design, Security, Infra). Teams surface blockers in ad-hoc channels which results in late discovery during sprints and reactive escalation. This ticket defines a standardized "Lane Orchestrator" concept and a clear blocker taxonomy so that dependency signals are triaged earlier, ownership is explicit, and automated dashboards drive remediation SLAs.

Proposal summary:
1) Create a Roadmap Lane Orchestrator (RLO) concept: each initiative has a cohort of lanes (Feature, Security, Infra, Design, Release) with owners and explicit handoff gates.
2) Introduce a blocker taxonomy and severity tiers aligned to release risk and customer impact: "Signal" (informational), "Constraint" (needs plan), "Blocker" (prevents ship), "Cutover Critical" (must resolve for launch).
3) Standardize intake fields for dependencies and blockers and publish a minimal API & Slack workflow for submit/acknowledge/resolve.
4) Ship a lightweight dashboard view in Console-Observability for PMs and Eng managers showing lane health, SLA ages, and next-action items.

Acceptance criteria:
- Confluence spec describing RLO lanes, roles, and gating checklist published (link in comments).
- Blocker taxonomy documented and adopted by at least 3 squads in Cycle 2025-W10 pilot.
- Intake template created (notion + GitHub Issues template) and Slack shortcut wired to create dependency issues.
- Dashboard prototype showing lane-level counts, average time-to-resolve, and per-team owners rolling for pilot squads.
- Automation rules created to escalate Blocker >48hrs to Eng leadership and PM on-call.

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Median time-to-detect cross-team blocker reduced from ~6 days to <48 hours.
- >70% of cross-team dependencies represented in RLO lanes at planning kickoff.
- Number of last-minute release delays attributed to undisclosed cross-team dependencies reduced by 50%.

Proposed taxonomy (short):
- Signal: informational dependency or alignment note. No blocking intent.
- Constraint: requires work but not on critical path. Track as risk with owner.
- Blocker: prevents other teams from progressing; needs an owner and a mitigation plan.
- Cutover Critical: must be resolved for the release/cutover; highest escalation and rollback triggers.

Ownership and flow:
- PM creates initiative and assigns lane owners during roadmap planning.
- Each lane owner registers lane dependencies in the intake template and assigns severity.
- Automated notifier assigns an owner ticket and posts to a lane-specific Slack channel.
- If a Blocker remains open past SLA (48 hours), automated escalation to Eng Director and PM lead.

Automation and integrations:
- Intake: Notion template + GitHub Issue template + Slack shortcut (prototype links in comments).
- Dashboard: Console dashboard pulls from Linear tags + GitHub labels + a small webhook ingestion service (infra collaboration required).
- Notifications: Slack + email; optional OpsGenie integration for Cutover Critical.

Pilot plan:
- Phase 0 (Week 1): Publish spec and intake templates; run a training session with pilot squads (Infra, Serving Runtime, Console).
- Phase 1 (Weeks 2–4): Capture lane registrations for active initiatives; iterate templates.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Wire dashboard and escalation rules; run first mock cutover rehearsal.
- Phase 3 (Week 9): Evaluate, measure success metrics, and iterate before company-wide rollout.

Open risks and trade-offs:
- Additional process overhead for small teams; mitigate by keeping intake minimal and providing automation.
- Dashboard depends on reliable cross-system tags (Linear/GH); may require short-term manual sync.
- Escalation fatigue if false positives occur; calibrate severity thresholds in pilot.

Immediate next steps (owner initiations):
- Aisha: Draft Confluence spec v0.1 and share with PM/Eng leads by 2025-02-18.
- Marco: Build intake GH issue template and Slack shortcut prototype by 2025-02-22.
- Priya (Design lead): Prepare lane checklist for Design handoffs by 2025-02-20.
- Infra (TBD): Estimate dashboard ingestion effort and provide stub endpoint by 2025-02-28.
